identification.summary: Ruza Flood is Microsoft's name for a Russia-affiliated influence operation that Microsoft also labels Doppelganger [S1]. The Doppelganger campaign was publicly named by EU DisinfoLab in September 2022 as a network using clones of at least 17 media outlets (including Bild, 20minutes, ANSA, The Guardian and RBC Ukraine) with fake articles, videos and polls [S5]. This is an influence operation, not an intrusion set.
identification.firstObserved: Doppelganger cloned-media activity was publicly documented by EU DisinfoLab in 2022-09 [S5]. Meta's Q3 2022 threat report (2022-11) covers a Russia-origin network but does not use the name Doppelganger in the sources gathered [S6]. The date Microsoft first assigned the name Ruza Flood is not established.
identification.notes: Microsoft equates Ruza Flood with Doppelganger [S1]. Microsoft tracks Storm-1516 and Storm-1679 as separate actors that it says synchronized messaging with Ruza Flood [S1]; do not merge them. Facts about Doppelganger from non-Microsoft sources (EU DisinfoLab, Meta, DOJ, UK) are assumed to describe the same operation because Microsoft equates the names; Microsoft's own tracking boundaries are not published in the sources gathered.

attribution.sponsor: Meta linked a Russia-origin network to two Russian companies, Structura National Technologies and Social Design Agency, in a December 2022 update to its Q3 2022 report [S6]. US DOJ (as reported) attributed Doppelganger to Social Design Agency, Structura and ANO Dialog acting under the direction of the Russian Presidential Administration [S2]. The UK sanctioned all three firms on 2024-10-28 [S4]. Microsoft's own sponsor attribution is not established in the sources gathered.
attribution.confidence: DOJ statements are government allegations reported second-hand, not Microsoft findings [S2]. Microsoft's confidence statements on Ruza Flood could not be verified from the sources gathered.
attribution.basis: US DOJ announcement as reported [S2]; Meta company attribution [S6]; UK sanctions as reported [S4]; Microsoft reporting via press coverage [S1].

objectives: Per Microsoft (via press coverage), in the 2024 US election cycle Ruza Flood, Storm-1516 and Storm-1679 made a synchronized shift from targeting President Biden to undermining Vice President Harris [S1]. DOJ (as reported) said the domains aimed to influence voters in US and foreign elections [S2].

sectors: Voters and general public (US 2024 election audience)
regions: Europe: Germany, France, Italy, Ukraine media brands cloned [S5]
targeting.notes: Spoofed outlets named by EU DisinfoLab include Bild, 20minutes, ANSA, The Guardian and RBC Ukraine [S5]. UK describes the operation as cloning legitimate websites and social media pages [S4].

capabilities.summary: Cloned news websites on look-alike domains with fake articles, videos and polls [S5]. DOJ (as reported) cited cybersquatting, fabricated influencers and fake profiles promoting AI-generated narratives [S2]. Press coverage of Microsoft's report ties Ruza Flood and Storm-1516 to fake videos, including one pushed via a fabricated San Francisco news outlet [S1].

campaigns.name: Doppelganger media-cloning campaign publicly named
campaigns.summary: EU DisinfoLab documents clones of at least 17 media providers using dozens of purchased domains to host fake articles, videos and polls.

campaigns.name: Meta Q3 2022 threat report
campaigns.summary: Meta publishes its Q3 2022 adversarial threat report covering a Russia-origin network first reported 2022-09-27; a December 2022 update links it to Structura and Social Design Agency.

campaigns.name: DOJ seizure of 32 domains and US sanctions
campaigns.summary: DOJ announces seizure of 32 domains tied to Doppelganger and attributes it to SDA, Structura and ANO Dialog under the direction of the Russian Presidential Administration.

campaigns.name: Microsoft election report on Russian actors
campaigns.summary: Press coverage of a Microsoft Threat Analysis Center report: Ruza Flood (Doppelganger), Storm-1516 and Storm-1679 shift focus to undermining the Harris campaign.

campaigns.name: UK sanctions
campaigns.summary: UK sanctions SDA, Structura, ANO Dialog and three senior managers (Gambashidze, Tupikin, Perla) over Doppelganger.

diamond.adversary: Russian firms Social Design Agency, Structura and ANO Dialog, alleged by DOJ to act under direction of the Russian Presidential Administration [S2][S6].
diamond.capability: Spoofed news sites, AI-generated narratives, fake personas and influencers [S2][S5].
diamond.infrastructure: Dozens of look-alike domains, 32 of which DOJ seized in September 2024 [S2][S5].
diamond.victim: US and European audiences; impersonated media brands [S1][S5].
diamond.socioPolitical: Undermining the Harris campaign in the 2024 US election cycle, per press coverage of Microsoft reporting [S1].
diamond.technology: Open web domains, social media advertising platforms, and generative AI tools [S2].

gaps: Microsoft's primary Ruza Flood reporting could not be opened or confirmed; Microsoft's sponsor and confidence statements (including any ANO Dialog or Kremlin-direction assessment) are unverified and were removed.
The Microsoft Security Insider URL previously cited could not be confirmed and was replaced by press coverage; exact report date is unknown (September 2024).
The Treasury releases and The Hacker News March 2024 source were not verified and were removed.
Whether Microsoft's Ruza Flood boundaries equal the full multi-year Doppelganger activity is not stated.
Activity after November 2024 is not covered; no 2025-2026 sources were gathered.
Microsoft first-observed date for the Ruza Flood name is unknown.

implications.jipoe: Analyst assessment derived from cited sources; validate before use. STEP 1: Key terrain is the information environment, specifically look-alike news domains, paid social advertising and influencer channels reaching US audiences. STEP 2: DOJ alleges the adversary uses commercial PR and IT firms under Russian Presidential Administration direction [S2]. STEP 3: Template is domain cloning, AI-generated narratives and fake personas, shifting themes with the news cycle [S2][S5]. STEP 4: MLCOA is continued election- and Ukraine-themed content on replacement domains after seizures. Candidate indicators: newly registered domains imitating major outlets, coordinated persona networks, and synchronized theme shifts across Russian-affiliated actors [S1][S5].
implications.jcc2: Analyst assessment derived from cited sources; validate before use. Situational awareness: track Microsoft and DOJ domain-seizure disclosures for IW indicators. Authorities: influence operations are largely outside DoD network defense and require coordination with interagency partners such as DOJ, Treasury and FBI. Mission assurance: brief personnel on spoofed media and social ads. Coordination: share indicators with public affairs, cyber and intelligence staffs and with platform providers.
